[[T'Charek Haathi]]'s '''grandmother''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] and ran a successful shipping company. She employed her granddaughter during her teenage years, until T'Charek left the business to join the [[Wroonian defense force]].<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
